name: cant help being a gemini
source:
Gloria is not an Alpha, not an Omega... she's both? How will she maneuver a world that only sees one or the other? How will she fall in love if only half of her heart is ever considered? And will she ever fix her VCR?

[From [url=https://paintedhouses.itch.io/cant-help-being-a-gemini]itch.io[/url]]
